name: wstudio
description: WStudio desktop editor with a Rust/Tauri host and Vue 3 frontend.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:tauri && npm run build:core-plugins
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:rust
scripts.test:tauri: npm run test:native-api && npm run test:rust && npm run test:release-tools
scripts.build:core-plugins: npm run build:core-plugin:file-explorer && npm run build:core-plugin:web-viewer && npm run build:core-plugin:outline
scripts.build:core-plugin:file-explorer: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='plugin/core-plugins/file-explorer'; for (const f of ['manifest.json','main.js','styles.css']) { if (!fs.statSync(p+'/'+f).isFile()) throw new Error('Missing '+p+'/'+f); } console.log('file-explorer package validated')"
scripts.build:core-plugin:web-viewer: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='plugin/core-plugins/web-viewer'; for (const f of ['manifest.json','main.js','styles.css']) { if (!fs.statSync(p+'/'+f).isFile()) throw new Error('Missing '+p+'/'+f); } console.log('web-viewer package validated')"
scripts.build:core-plugin:outline: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const p='plugin/core-plugins/outline'; for (const f of ['manifest.json','main.js','styles.css']) { if (!fs.statSync(p+'/'+f).isFile()) throw new Error('Missing '+p+'/'+f); } console.log('outline package validated')"
